description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PA25/3688 for Replacement of existing Brentford Gate ticket kiosks - to allow relocating the proposed building to the northeast by 1.1m; reduction in overall building length by 2m; simplification of external metalwork and railings; reduced new resin-bound gravel external surface; and addition of small external storage box for wheelchairs to replace internal storage room.
decision_conditions:
For the avoidance of doubt the Drawing(s) No(s) and Document(s) to which this decision refers are as follows:
290-A-A1001-Brentford Gate - Proposed Site Plan; 290-A-A1010-Brentford Gate - Proposed Ground Floor Plan; 290-A-A1011-Brentford Gate - Proposed Roof Plan; 290-A-A1020-Brentford Gate - Proposed Sections AA and BB; 290-A-A1030-Brentford Gate - Proposed North-East and South-West Elevations; 290-A-A1032-Brentford Gate - Proposed South-East and North-West Elevations; 290-A-A1035-Brentford Gate - External Metalwork; 290-A-A1038-Brentford Gate - Proposed Hard Landscaping Plan - all received by the Local Planning Authority on 03/11/2026
